relations.text: Steve Maddenが10-Kで、卸売の上位10顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Steve Madden lists Burlington among its top ten wholesale customers

source.label: Steve Madden 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, our top ten wholesale channel customers, in no particular order, included: Nordstrom, Macy's, Dillard's, Designer Brands, The TJX Companies, Ross Stores, Burlington Stores, Amazon, Walmart, and Target.

relations.text: Guessが10-Kで、米州の卸売顧客の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Guess lists Burlington first among its Americas wholesale customers

source.label: Guess 10-K(2025年1月期)
source.quote: In the Americas, our wholesale customers consist primarily of department stores, including Burlington Stores, Liverpool, Nordstrom, Macy's and Hudson's Bay

relations.text: RossがCEO雇用契約で、競合事業の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Ross names Burlington first among competing off-price retailers in its CEO agreement

source.label: Ross Stores 10-K(2024年度) 添付の雇用契約
source.quote: any off-price retailer including, without limitation, Burlington Stores, Inc. and The TJX Companies, Inc.;

relations.text: Kohl'sが契約で、競合の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Kohl's lists Burlington as a competitor in an agreement

source.label: Kohl's 10-K(2024年度) 添付の契約
source.quote: The term "Competitor" means Amazon.com, Inc., Belk, Inc., Burlington Stores, Inc., Dillard's, Inc.

relations.text: Citi Trendsが契約で、競合の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Citi Trends lists Burlington as a competitor in an agreement

source.label: Citi Trends 10-K(2024年度) 添付の契約
source.quote: the term " Competitor " shall mean only the following businesses, commonly known as: Cato, TJX (including without limitation TJMAXX and Marshalls), Burlington Stores, Gabe's/Rugged Wearhouse, and Ross Stores.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
